title: consultant_answer
description: The consultant's answer to one question about one dossier (Implementation Decisions 9, map ticket 41): the answer, where in the dossier it was read, how sure the consultant is, whether the dossier is silent on it, and whether a full read of the paper would answer it. Both entry points return it: `wayline consult`, and an agent() call in a Workflow script. Code validates it again and holds one rule the schema leaves out (a top-level oneOf is not a tool input schema): an answer read in the source names at least one locator.

answer.description: the answer in the paper's own terms; when not_in_source is true, what the dossier does and does not say about the question

locators.description: where the answer was read, relative to the dossier directory: <file>:<line>, a page of a PDF, or an inventory item id such as eq-3; for a document, its block anchors such as p12

confidence.description: 0 is a guess, 1 is read verbatim

not_in_source.description: true when nothing in the dossier's files answers the question

promote_requested.description: true when the dossier is below level 2 and a full read of the paper would answer the question
